rules.name: pleasantries
rules.description: Drop common polite expressions in Russian/Ukrainian-style Cyrillic text.

rules.name: polite_framing
rules.pattern: \b(?:не могли бы вы|могли бы вы|прошу вас|будьте добры)\b\s*
rules.description: Remove polite framing that doesn't change intent.

rules.name: hedging
rules.description: Remove hedging words in Cyrillic prose.

rules.name: redundant_openers
rules.description: Strip common greetings from user messages.

rules.name: filler_adverbs
rules.description: Remove common filler adverbs/phrases in Cyrillic.
